dataset.name: HandNet
dataset.pointMask: segmap > 0 and depth > 0; every second pixel in each axis
dataset.sampling: Self-contained selection of 20 precomputed visualization frames from the 96-frame explorer preview, including 8 matched original/transformed pairs. Five test originals and five paired perturbed frames; three validation originals and three paired derotated frames; four training derotated frames. All coordinates, source metadata and visualization assets are copied unchanged; this subset is not the full dataset.
dataset.heatmapNotes: Six original source hmap channels; round(clip(value,0,1)*255) grayscale, fixed 0–1 scale, no foreground mask or synthetic Gaussian.
dataset.imageNotes: Depth uses per-frame foreground 2nd–98th percentile false color. IR uses nonzero 1st–99th percentile grayscale. Labels retain source IDs.
